summary: Iter 45 — Automatic lead classification (real/test lanes) + booking-invite + AI summary exclusion + multi-tenant backfill. Backend suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter45_lead_classify.py: 13/14 pass, 1 skipped (no email-less lead to test), 0 failures relevant to the feature. Classification correctness verified end-to-end: public POST /api/public/contact/{token} with fake payload (QA Bot v2 / qa@mailinator.com / 'TEST TEST TEST') lands lane='test' with 3+ lane_reasons at write time; realistic payload (Sarah Thompson @acme-industries.co, natural-language message) lands lane='real'. POST /api/apps/{id}/inbox/classify?rerun=true returns {classified,real,test}. GET /api/apps/{id}/inbox returns counts {real,test,archived,review,priority} and ?lane=real / ?lane=test filter cleanly; unread and hot counts exclude lane='test'. PATCH /api/apps/{id}/inbox/{msg}/lane sets lane_manual=true and survives a subsequent classify?rerun=true (sticky). Invalid lane returns 400; unknown message id returns 404. POST /api/apps/{id}/inbox/{msg}/booking-invite on a real lead returns invite.to = lead email and copies contains BOTH JLBUSINESS2020@gmail.com AND jaybernabe@luciodigital.com, stores booking_invite on the message and marks it read; on a test lead returns 400 with the expected message. POST /api/apps/{id}/ai/lead-summary counts respect lane exclusion. Multi-tenant backfill verified on app_e3cb4f084785 and app_abc693a75574 — GET /api/apps/{id}/inbox lazily classifies previously unclassified leads (all messages have a lane). Frontend Inbox tab on Northwind Roofing renders every required data-testid: inbox-tabs / inbox-tab-real (active, count 3) / inbox-tab-test (count 3) / inbox-tab-archived (0), secondary chips inbox-filter-all/hot/unread/starred, inbox-section-priority with lead-priority-flame for score 95 Sarah Thompson, inbox-section-review, inbox-count-priority (1) and inbox-count-review (0). Test tab shows 3 lead-test-badge rows with lead-move-real-row buttons. Detail pane on both lanes shows lead-lane-badge and lead-move-lane-btn; Real detail additionally shows lead-booking-invite-btn. The 'Your week in leads' summary card explicitly says '3 lead(s), 0 hot' — confirms test leads excluded from the AI weekly summary (only 3 real leads counted, not 6). No regressions on tabs/navigation.

minor.issue: Email delivery is a graceful no-op in preview (wf.send_email returns non-'sent'), so invite.to is set from msg.from_email but the code path relies on wf.send_email being present to append copies. Currently working correctly because wf.send_email is registered in preview and returns success — but if it ever throws, copies list will be empty even though the message gets stored. Not a blocker.

critical_code_review_comments: lead_class.classify: _name_looks_fake uses non-standard word boundary regex — 'Sample City' would flip a real lead (contains 'sample'). TEST_NAME_WORDS 'sample' is broad; consider using stricter matching (whole token) or a shorter list. Currently acceptable because it errs on the safe side (over-classifying as test) and Admin can override.

inbox.py app_inbox counts.priority uses score > 60 but the review-section badge in the copy says 'score > 60' and the review-section says 'score < 30' — but counts.review uses `review: True` (from lead_class), not `score < 30`. Users see 'review · score under 30, may be suspicious' section header but membership is actually driven by classifier flags (free domain, short message, no name). Small copy/logic mismatch, not a bug.

inbox.py _new_message doesn't pass meta from public_contact — meta is None so 'automated' / user_agent / seeded signals from the request are never used. Consider forwarding request.headers['user-agent'] for playwright detection.

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 relevant tests pass; 1 skip on missing seed data)
